newsitem.title: USA: Correctional stake held by Zweig-DiMenna group.
newsitem.headline: Correctional stake held by Zweig-DiMenna group.

text.p: A group including Zweig-DiMenna Special Opportunities L.P. said Friday it has acquired a 6.7 percent stake or 506,500 common shares in Correctional Services Corp.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the stake for $6.72 million and holds it for investment.
It said it bought the shares between October 18 and November 13 at prices ranging from $10.25 to $14.00 a share.
Correctional Services is a Sarasota, Fla., developer and manager of privatized prison facilities in the U.S.
